signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary CTA fill, active states, brand wordmark, link emphasis — the only chromatic blue with enough surface area to carry identity

aurora-gradient.$description: Aurora Gradient — Hero CTA gradient, brand wordmark highlight, selected-state washes — flows from sky-blue to electric violet

electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Gradient terminus, brand-secondary accent — appears only as the cool half of the aurora

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

hyper-pink.$description: Hyper Pink — Accent spectrum — demonstration option in the wallet-customization showcase, not a UI-state color

ember-red.$description: Ember Red — Accent spectrum — demonstration option in wallet-customization showcase

solar-orange.$description: Solar Orange — Accent spectrum — demonstration option in wallet-customization showcase

toxic-green.$description: Toxic Green — Accent spectrum — demonstration option in wallet-customization showcase

void.$description: Void — Page canvas, deepest surfaces, inverted button borders — true black anchors the entire system

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Card surfaces, code blocks, modal containers, body text on light — the workhorse elevated surface

shadow.$description: Shadow — Shadow tint color (used in box-shadow rgba), near-black with a hint of warmth

graphite.$description: Graphite — Hairline borders, dividers, icon stroke, secondary text on dark — the most-used neutral border in the system

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary borders, subtle dividers between sections — sits between Graphite and Pewter

carbon.$description: Carbon — Tertiary icon fills, disabled-state borders, subtle backgrounds

pewter.$description: Pewter — Disabled button background, low-emphasis surfaces — never for text

fog.$description: Fog — Muted helper text, icon secondary, placeholder text — the only gray that carries readable information

snow.$description: Snow — Primary text, inverted button fill, light-surface backgrounds, icon glyphs, hairline highlight borders

mist.$description: Mist — Light-theme surface fallback, very subtle off-white for section backgrounds on the demo

sfrounded.$description: Primary typeface for all UI — rounded geometric sans, chosen because the soft terminals make technical Web3 copy feel approachable rather than intimidating

sfmono.$description: Code snippets, terminal commands, technical strings — the npm install command in the hero

system-ui.$description: Fallback body copy when the web font hasn't loaded — barely visible because SFRounded dominates

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
